name: B10-0213/2026 (S&D) – The need for targeted criminal provisions and platforms’ responsibility to effectively address cyberbullying and online harassment
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for targeted criminal provisions and platforms’ responsibility to effectively address cyberbullying and online harassment
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking for stronger action against cyberbullying and online harassment. It wants the European Commission to consider an EU law on the most serious forms of online bullying, to enforce existing platform rules more strictly, and to make reporting easier for victims. It also calls for more money for victim support, helplines and digital education. This is the Parliament's opinion and request; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks for possible new EU criminal rules and tougher enforcement of platform duties.
- **Who it affects:** Children, victims of online abuse, online platforms, schools and support services.
- **What happens next:** The Commission decides whether to propose laws; Member States are asked to share best practices.
